payload.name: Assembly
payload.description: Assembly types must always have a BOM on their first process. Assembly types may consume other assembly, byproduct, inventory or phantoms in their BOMs.

payload.name: Inventory
payload.description: Inventory Strategy Types - should ONLY allow a single process be added - these types of products can ONLY be purchased OR the output of a Parent product strategy type.

payload.name: Parent
payload.description: Parent product Strategies are those that define a single schedulable product/tool/etc. This type of strategy should ALWAYS result in its final production process - to create co-products (either inventory or assembly products). Parent types should never be the "Final" product / technically not even an inventory item (as it should represent a collection of individual child outputs)

payload.name: Phantom
payload.description: Phantom types are "pass through" - meaning they are never produced, the items contained within their BOM are pushed up to the consuming process. Phantom Types - must be configured like any other Assembly type - however, should ONLY have 1 process, and that 1 process MUST have a BOM attached.
